title: Rạng Đông: an AI assistant supporting dealers through the purchasing journey
summary: An AI assistant that helps dealers look up products and place orders, with clear commercial handoffs.

blocks.text: Dealers need to look up products, stock and policies and place orders quickly, while the sales team cannot answer every repeated question.

items: The product catalog is large with many technical specifications.
Commercial requests must be routed to the right person.

blocks.text: I was Product Owner: clarifying dealer support scenarios, organizing the product knowledge base, and designing conversation flows and handoff rules for staff.

items: Answers are based on the product and situation the dealer is asking about.
Quotes, discounts and special orders go to the right department.

blocks.alt: Illustration: the dealer portal and support assistant
blocks.caption: Illustration: the dealer portal and support assistant

items: In B2B, answering in the dealer's context matters more than answering a lot.
The boundary between AI and the sales team must be clear from the start.
